title: Quant Ruleset Onboarding + Calibration Validation Playbook
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Purpose:
Create a reproducible ruleset and onboarding playbook that prescribes a per-model default quantization profile (FP8 and INT8 candidates), a staged calibration workflow, and automated accuracy validation gates for the model catalog. The deliverable is a machine-readable ruleset + human playbook that can be used by model-owners, SRE, and the catalog onboarding pipeline to pick safe defaults and trigger shadow/rollout behavior.

Scope:
- Produce rules to recommend an initial quant profile based on model family, weight distribution stats, activation dynamics, and fingerprinted workload samples.
- Define a 3-stage calibration pipeline (local calibration -> shadow runs -> canary) and the metrics/gates for each stage.
- Provide guardrail thresholds and automated rollback / fallback policies for catalog entries.
- Integrate validation harness (eval sets, embedding/LM metrics) and CI gating for PRs that change quant defaults.

Out of scope:
- Building per-layer custom quant compilers (we will call the compiler team infra-requests).
- New quant primitives beyond FP8/INT8; future work item.
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable ruleset (YAML) that returns a recommended profile for any catalog model and documentation explaining decision factors
Calibration pipeline implemented as templated workflow in catalog onboarding that runs three stages and emits a report
Automated validation gate: if any primary metric regresses beyond thresholds (see guardrails) the onboarding fails and triggers fallback to higher-precision baseline
CI job that runs a lightweight shadow evaluation for PRs changing catalog quant defaults and fails on metric regression
Runbook for operators that explains manual override, emergency rollback, and how to escalate to compiler/serving teams
plan: 1) Instrument model fingerprinting: add hooks to capture weight histograms, activation stat snapshots, and representative input samples when a model is added to catalog
2) Define ruleset schema: fields = model_family, layer_type_counts, weight_entropy, activation_skew, typical_seq_len, task_family (LM/embed/decoder), preferred_latency_budget
3) Build candidate profiles: enumerate FP8 E4M3/E5M2 presets, INT8 symmetric-per-channel + dynamic-activations, and a "safe" FP16 baseline
4) Calibration step templates: local PTQ calibration (per-layer clipping + KL/MAE objective), full-model shadow runs on a sample workload, and small-scale canary serving with traffic split
5) Validation harness: select evaluation suites (QA prompts, MMLU slices, embedding similarity sets) and define metric computation scripts
6) Telemetry & gates: wire the validation metrics into the onboarding workflow; implement pass/fail thresholds and automated fallback triggers
7) CI integration: add a GitHub Actions job to run the lightweight eval for catalog changes and block merges on regression
8) Documentation & runbook: publish playbook with examples, troubleshooting, and escalation paths
9) Pilot: onboard 3 diverse models (small LLaMA-7B-family variant, instruction-tuned chat model, and an embedding-only model) and iterate ruleset parameters
validation_metrics: primary_lm_delta: change in perplexity / token-level logprob (relative)
task_exact_match_delta: % change in exact match for structured QA slices
embedding_cosine_drop: % drop in average cosine similarity vs FP16 baseline
latency_p95_increase: relative increase in server-side p95 token latency
generation_quality_regression_score: aggregated human-derived regression signal when available
guardrails: Reject if primary_lm_delta > 2.0% (relative) for general-purpose LMs
Reject if task_exact_match_delta > 1.5 percentage points for evaluation slices labeled 'business-critical'
Reject if embedding_cosine_drop > 0.8% for production embedding models
Reject if latency_p95_increase > 10% compared to FP16 baseline (unless cost improvement > 30%)
Require manual review if generation_quality_regression_score > 0.5 (on 0-1 scale)
Hard fallback: if any regression occurs in canary, serve FP16 baseline and open incident ticket
fallback_chain: fallback-2: route to hosted-compatibility-variant (smaller context optimized)
fallback-3: degrade to reduced max_tokens / constrained batch size to preserve latency SLOs
manual-override: model-owner can force 'always FP16' flag in catalog entry
comments: 2026-02-26 Priya Nair: Initial draft of ruleset schema attached. Shared with compiler and runtime teams for early feedback.
2026-03-02 Liam Chen: Ran local PTQ on LLaMA-7B variant. FP8 E5M2 profile passed basic perplexity check but embedding cosine drift ~0.6% — within guardrail for non-embedding tasks.
2026-03-04 Sofie Park (runtime): Noted that per-channel symmetric INT8 requires slight allocator change; filing infra follow-up ENG-125678.
2026-03-07 Support: added a note about how to interpret generation_quality_regression_score; proposed human review threshold at 0.5.
2026-03-10 Liam Chen: Integrated lightweight CI eval job. Example run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/actions/runs/312345678 — passed for pilot-embed-model with FP8 candidate.
2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Updated guardrail thresholds after pilot; lowered acceptable LM delta from 3% -> 2% for LMs per stakeholder request.
notes: Decision: Use a hybrid ruleset that prefers FP8 E4M3 for low-memory, non-embedding LMs with stable activation distributions, INT8 symmetric-per-channel for models with high weight sparsity and when latency predictability is critical.

Trade-off: FP8 gives better cost/throughput on A100-like hardware with minimal change to kernel stack, but has higher risk on models with heavy activation skew; those must go through stricter shadow validation.
Operational risk: ensure telemetry emits per-canary detailed diffs so runaway regressions are triaged before full rollout.
